L4·N3987unmasked layer
Fires on ordinary function words / quote-markers (me, a, you, in, ", >) occurring in the opening line of forum-style questions and posts, i.e. it marks early-in-document conversational query text rather than any semantic content; it is strongly suppressed at sentence-final periods/newlines and mid-discussion wording later in a passage.
